answer: Cluster identities by style, not by address. Each epoch, every agent must write a short sonnet on a shared prompt, and peers compare the drafts for shared quirks: the same rare rhymes, identical line breaks, matching typos. Fifty accounts run by one operator tend to write like one mind. Accounts whose drafts cluster too tightly get a sable mark, and their rewards split as if they were one agent. A violet badge goes only to identities whose voice stays distinct across many epochs.
